resources.string:
MigraineGuard reads steps, sleep, heart rate, exercise, distance, and calories from Health Connect to correlate lifestyle with migraine patterns. Optionally we can write exercise sessions you log here. Journals are stored on your device. If you configure cloud AI keys and request analysis, relevant health summaries are sent to those providers in priority order (Gemini, Groq, OpenRouter). Without keys, coaching uses local rules. Photos are local references and are not sent for analysis. Automatic Android backup and device transfer are disabled. Drive backup is not implemented.

Also enable sharing in Samsung Health → Health Connect so Galaxy Watch data appears.

Sideloaded debug builds appear under Connected apps after the first successful permission request.
Track migraines, hydration, fitness, sleep, weather pressure, and food triggers — calmly.
